admission.justification: Shared Markdown and context-specific openers prevent a document link from replacing the dashboard tab while permitting valid internal navigation.

applicability: Hyperlinks rendered by shared dashboard Markdown, repository-document links, and notes using the supplied notes document context.
conditions: Ordinary relative links prevent navigation of the dashboard's browser tab.
Repository and note contexts route valid internal file links through their own openers.
Outside HTTP and HTTPS hyperlinks open separately and local fragment links remain within their document.
exclusions: Browser navigation initiated outside rendered Markdown.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §9; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: keeps a relative link from moving the dashboard's own tab; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: opens an outside address in a new tab and keeps an anchor in the page; dashboard/src/panels/notes-reader/NotesReaderViewer.test.tsx :: follows a markdown note link to another note of the master

statement: A Markdown link cannot navigate the dashboard's own browser tab, and notes follow valid internal links through their document context.
